name: Boardshorts with Tropical Print
description: Boardshorts with a vibrant tropical print and a 30-inch inner seam for comfort. The quick-dry fabric resists chlorine, and the built-in mesh liner offers support. Ideal for surfing or beach volleyball.

reviews.title: Faded Print and Poor Fit
reviews.comment: The tropical print started to fade after the first wash, making the shorts look cheap. The elastic waistband dug into my hips and the length was too short for comfort. I expected a quick-dry fabric but it stayed soggy and heavy.

reviews.title: Color Bleeds, Still Uncomfortable
reviews.comment: The bright palm pattern looked great online, but it bled onto my skin and other clothes after a couple of swims. The material feels stiff and the side pockets are too shallow to hold anything useful. Even though the price was low, the overall quality is disappointing.
